name: Department of Finance - Government of Ajman
source_note: Collected from ajmandof.ae in October 2026. Review and update this file whenever the website changes.

contact.address: Department of Finance, Government of Ajman, Imam Malik bin Anas Street, Ajman, United Arab Emirates
contact.working_hours: Monday to Thursday 7:30 AM to 3:30 PM, Friday 7:30 AM to 12:00 noon. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
contact.online_channels: All services are requested online at ajmandof.ae under Services, by clicking Start Service and logging in with UAE PASS.
contact.feedback: Suggestions and complaints can be sent through the Customer Voice page under Digital Participation on ajmandof.ae.
contact.social_media: AjmanDOF on Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube, and Ajman Department of Finance on LinkedIn.

website_sections.services: Services: all eighteen e-services, grouped by audience.
website_sections.tenders: Tenders: current government tenders. Viewing is open to everyone, but taking part needs supplier registration on the Tawreed platform.
website_sections.open_data: Open Data: published financial data sets.
website_sections.legislation: Legislation and Governance: financial laws, decisions and policies.
website_sections.media_center: Media Center: news, events, photos and videos.
website_sections.digital_participation: Digital Participation: Customer Voice for suggestions and complaints.
website_sections.client_dashboard: Client Dashboard: track your submitted requests after logging in with UAE PASS.

supplier_registration.name: Supplier Registration Request
supplier_registration.description: Registers a company as an approved supplier so it can take part in Ajman Government procurement, tenders and supply contracts.
supplier_registration.documents: A copy of the valid commercial license.
supplier_registration.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose Supplier Registration Request, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the supplier form and submit.
supplier_registration.fees: 100 dirhams. Companies in the Ta'zeez, Bidaya and Ruyada programs are exempt.

supplier_renewal.name: Supplier Registration Renewal Request
supplier_renewal.description: Lets an approved supplier renew its registration to keep taking part in government tenders and procurement.
supplier_renewal.conditions: A valid commercial license and an active supplier account.
supplier_renewal.documents: A copy of the renewed commercial license.
supplier_renewal.steps: Log in with UAE PASS, go to Services, choose Renew License, enter the new license expiry date, attach the renewed license and submit. Suppliers registered with the Department of Economic Development can pull their data automatically.

supplier_update.name: Supplier Data Update Request
supplier_update.description: Lets a registered supplier update its registered details, for example bank details.
supplier_update.documents: Supporting documents for the change, for example a certificate from the bank.
supplier_update.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose Supplier Data Update Request, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the form, upload the supporting documents and submit.

sadad_wallet_create.name: Create Ajman Sadad Wallet
sadad_wallet_create.description: Opens a digital wallet on the Ajman Sadad platform for paying government fees and transactions. Provided with First Abu Dhabi Bank.
sadad_wallet_create.steps: Log in to Ajman Sadad with UAE PASS, scan your Emirates ID, fill in the required details and submit.

sadad_wallet_close.name: Close Ajman Sadad Wallet
sadad_wallet_close.description: Closes your Ajman Sadad digital wallet.
sadad_wallet_close.conditions: A UAE PASS digital identity and an active wallet.
sadad_wallet_close.steps: Log in to Ajman Sadad with UAE PASS, open My Wallet and Cards, choose Close Wallet and submit.

technical_support.name: Technical Support for Systems and Applications
technical_support.audience: Government entities and businesses using Department of Finance systems
technical_support.description: Reports a technical fault in a Department of Finance system or application and follows it up until it is fixed.
technical_support.documents: A screenshot or any document that clearly shows the problem.
technical_support.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose Technical Support Request, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, describe the problem, attach the screenshot and submit.

user_permissions.name: User Permissions for Systems and Applications
user_permissions.description: Creates, changes or cancels user permissions on Department of Finance systems and applications.
user_permissions.documents: None listed. A service card PDF is available on the service page.
user_permissions.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose User Permissions Request, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the form and submit.

financial_inquiries.name: Financial Inquiries and Consultations
financial_inquiries.description: Lets government entities ask about financial and accounting procedures in the Government of Ajman and get a consultation.
financial_inquiries.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose Financial Inquiries and Consultations, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the form and submit.

financial_transfer.name: Financial Transfer Request
financial_transfer.description: Amends an entity's approved budget by moving allocations between its programs.
financial_transfer.conditions: Must comply with the decisions setting authority limits for financial transfers.
financial_transfer.documents: Supporting documents, for example proof of the allocation estimate or justification of need.
financial_transfer.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose Financial Transfer Request, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the form, upload the documents and submit.

supplementary_appropriation.name: Supplementary Appropriation Request
supplementary_appropriation.description: Requests funding beyond the allocations already approved in the entity's financial plan.
supplementary_appropriation.documents: Supporting documents, for example proof of the budget estimate or justification of need.
supplementary_appropriation.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose Supplementary Appropriation Request, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the form, upload the documents and submit.

job_budget_amendment.name: Job Budget Amendment Request
job_budget_amendment.description: Cancels existing job vacancies and creates new ones in the entity's job budget.
job_budget_amendment.conditions: The total value of the new vacancies must equal the total value of the cancelled ones.
job_budget_amendment.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose Job Budget Amendment Request, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the form and submit.

multi_year_contract.name: Approval to Sign a Contract Beyond the Fiscal Year
multi_year_contract.name_ar: طلب توقيع عقد يترتب عليه التزام مالي يتجاوز السنة المالية
multi_year_contract.description: Approval to sign a contract whose financial commitment runs past one fiscal year.
multi_year_contract.documents: The extended contract signing form and supporting documents for the financial estimate.
multi_year_contract.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose this service, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the form, upload the documents and submit.

bank_account_open.name: Bank Account Opening Request
bank_account_open.description: Opens a bank account for a government entity at a local bank or financial institution.
bank_account_open.conditions: Must comply with the Amiri decisions on financial and banking authority in the Government of Ajman.
bank_account_open.documents: The entity's establishment decree, the administrative decision granting banking powers, the Amiri decree appointing the Director General, an official request letter from the Director General, bank signature specimens, and valid passport and Emirates ID copies of the authorized signatories.
bank_account_open.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose Bank Account Opening Request, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the form, upload the documents and submit.

bank_account_close.name: Bank Account Closure Request
bank_account_close.description: Closes a government bank account whose purpose has ended, at the entity's request or on the Department's recommendation.
bank_account_close.conditions: Must comply with the Amiri decisions on financial and banking authority.
bank_account_close.documents: An official letter from the entity's Director General requesting the closure.
bank_account_close.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose Bank Account Closure Request, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the form and submit.

activity_definition.name: Define, Modify or Deactivate an Activity
activity_definition.name_ar: طلب تعريف أو تعديل أو إلغاء تفعيل نشاط
activity_definition.description: Defines, changes or deactivates an activity in the Cloud Resources system and the Ajman Sadad platform.
activity_definition.documents: The Amiri decree related to the activity and the activity definition form.
activity_definition.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose this service, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the form, upload the documents and submit.

chart_of_accounts.name: Add a New Account to the Government Chart of Accounts
chart_of_accounts.name_ar: طلب إضافة حساب جديد في شجرة الحسابات الحكومية
chart_of_accounts.description: Adds a new account to the government chart of accounts to suit the entity's accounting needs.
chart_of_accounts.documents: The chart of accounts account-opening form, downloadable from the service page.
chart_of_accounts.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose this service, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the form, upload the form and submit.

legislation_impact_study.name: Financial Impact Study of Government Legislation
legislation_impact_study.name_ar: طلب دراسة الأثر المالي للتشريعات الحكومية
legislation_impact_study.audience: Government entities, including the Legislation Committee of the Emirate of Ajman
legislation_impact_study.description: Studies how proposed or existing legislation affects government revenues and expenditures.
legislation_impact_study.documents: The draft legislation and a full preliminary study of the issues it addresses.
legislation_impact_study.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose this service, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the form, upload the documents and submit.

fees_penalties_study.name: Study of Updating Service Fees and Violation Penalties
fees_penalties_study.name_ar: طلب دراسة تحديث رسوم الخدمات وجزاءات المخالفات
fees_penalties_study.description: Reviews a government entity's request to update its service fees or violation penalties.
fees_penalties_study.conditions: Must follow the Government Services Cost Calculation and Pricing Guide.
fees_penalties_study.documents: The draft legislation, a benchmarking form, an expected impact report, cost analysis tables, historical collection statements, a financial forecast report, and for penalties a monitoring and inspection cost analysis.
fees_penalties_study.steps: Go to ajmandof.ae, open Services, choose this service, click Start Service, log in with UAE PASS, fill in the form, upload the documents and submit.

faq.a: Tawreed is the Ajman Government e-procurement platform. Registered suppliers use it to take part in tenders, procurement and supply contracts. It supports Arabic and English and has live chat from the icon on its home page.

faq.q: Can I view tenders without registering?
faq.a: Yes. Anyone can view tenders published by Ajman Government entities. To submit an offer, you must be registered as a supplier on Tawreed.

faq.q: Is there a fee to take part in tenders?
faq.a: There is no fee to take part in a tender. There is only a one-time supplier registration fee of 100 dirhams, and renewal is free.

faq.q: Does logging in with UAE PASS register me as a supplier?
faq.a: No. Logging in with UAE PASS only creates a user account. To register as a supplier, go to Services and submit a Supplier Registration Request.

faq.q: What is the deadline for submitting offers?
faq.a: Each tender has its own closing date. Submit well before the deadline so the Department can help if you hit a technical problem.
All offers must go through Tawreed. Sealed envelopes are accepted only if the platform has a technical problem, following the applicable procedures.
Criteria differ by tender and can include price, quality, experience and meeting the technical requirements.

faq.q: How will I know the tender result?
faq.a: Winning companies are usually notified through the Tawreed platform or by email.

faq.q: How do I contact a tender official?
faq.a: The contact details for each tender are listed in that tender's information on Tawreed.

faq.q: Are there training sessions for suppliers?
faq.a: Yes. Workshops and training sessions are held from time to time, and invitations are emailed to registered suppliers.

faq.q: How do I get technical support on Tawreed?
faq.a: Use the Contact Us feature on Tawreed to request technical support, make a complaint or give feedback. You can also call 80070.

faq.q: How do I track my request?
faq.a: Log in with UAE PASS and open the Client Dashboard on ajmandof.ae to see the status of your requests. You can also call 80070.
